execution.interpretation: Independent geometry/fluid evaluations and service/design closures are dispatched in deterministic input order. Parallelism changes wall-clock time only; each worker uses the same registered transient solver, grid, tolerance and integer-closure algorithm.

scientific_question: Which molten-salt, storage-unit and skeleton choices retain a material advantage after common-pore inventory, finite-rate transport, structural grading, self-consistent modular service and evidence limits are imposed?
core_hypothesis: A fluid's intrinsic volumetric-energy advantage is not a system property. Its retained value is governed by pore inventory displacement, particle-scale resistance, thermocline quality, hydraulics, modular power constraints and evidence completeness.
claim_boundary: V16 is an evidence-gated reference-scale co-design and self-consistent fixed-service comparison. It uses a conservative one-dimensional LTNE finite-volume model with MUSCL advection, exact interphase exchange, explicit particle resistance and counter-flow discharge. Every baseline material-topology case is confirmed on a 2048-cell axial mesh; every retained decision-resolution case is independently reclosed at 4096 cells before release. The DLR air experiment tests transferable packed-bed model behavior. It does not validate molten-salt chemistry. Salt-skeleton compatibility, corrosion, wetting, long-cycle stability, structural design, cost and EPC feasibility remain gated.
frozen_property_registry_note: The five fluid property model identifiers retain the V10 suffix because their source-registered equations are unchanged. V16 changes numerical resolution, hydraulic screening, service closure, decision precision, robustness, validation tiers and reporting. It does not silently replace property evidence.

array_header_hydraulics.model: two-level balanced square-array Darcy-Weisbach friction screen with one trunk and one lateral supply-return pair; uniform module flow is prescribed and fittings, valves, heat exchangers and site-specific manifolds are excluded

service_model.model_scope: parallel modular packed zones; discrete unit count, bed friction and a geometry-normalized on-array header-friction screen are included. Tank shells, fittings, valves, heat exchangers, site-specific trunk routing, flow maldistribution and balance of plant are excluded. Hydraulic values are screening metrics, not installed-pump specifications.

module_scale_sensitivity.interpretation: Extrapolative model-domain sensitivity with diameter and height scaled together and nominal mass flow scaled with cross-sectional area to preserve superficial velocity. Shell stress, manifolds, valves, heat exchangers, installation count, cost and EPC feasibility are not solved.

service_monotonicity_audit.scope: full integer scan from the power lower bound to the reported minimum for every retained decision-resolution case; a stratified all-service probe separately searches for non-monotone capacity increments before the exact-front audit

decision_precision.interpretation: Decision-resolution fronts use epsilon boxes. Exact fronts are retained only as audit outputs. The widths represent engineering resolution, not probability. Release is blocked unless 4096-cell reclosure of every retained 2048-cell decision case is within the numerical acceptance bounds.

model_form_stress.interpretation: These are deterministic model-form stress cases. Every nonzero effective surface coefficient is referenced to the explicitly registered 25 C ambient sink and converted for each unit using A/V = 4/D + 2/H. The registered values are engineering stress bounds, not transferred calibration values, measurements or probability distributions.

standby_loss.interpretation: Uniform-hot inventory screen with registered effective surface coefficients converted by each unit's external area-to-packed-volume ratio. It bounds standby sensitivity and is not a thermocline-cycle validation.

verification.threshold_interpretation: Deterministic decision-threshold sensitivity. The cooling holdout discrepancy is from an air packed bed and is not transferred as a molten-salt probability distribution or correction.

numerical_decision_validation.scope: Every retained 2048-cell decision-resolution case is reclosed at 4096 cells. The release fails if any registered capacity, high-grade fraction or integer-count tolerance is exceeded. This candidate-level refinement validates reporting resolution; it does not turn the one-dimensional model into chemistry or plant validation.

bounded_property_uncertainty.interpretation: Latin-hypercube frequency under registered bounds is a non-probabilistic stress diagnostic, not a probability distribution. Missing uncertainty is retained as missing.
